properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-20: the owner corrected the prior resolution (which had P27 'absorbed into the hospital's own footprint, not a separate parcel') using the numbered real-gap-fragment technique -- fragment 29 (11,734 sqm), a real oval running track with a central grass field and surrounding path, sits as its own real feature just south of the hospital campus, bounded by real streets on all sides and not overlapping any already-tracked polygon. Used as-is, no trim needed. 2026-09-29 accuracy audit: FLAGGED FOR THE OWNER, nothing changed. Nothing is cited for the identification of fragment 29 as P27, and the audit found it doubtful: the traced oval (centroid about -122.3915, 37.7647; 11,722 sqm) sits just north of Mariposa St and just west of 4th St, where Mariposa Park is (Potrero View, 2016-03-19: 'located ... at Mariposa and Fourth streets'; SF Rec & Park: 'Mariposa Street and Owens'; UCSF's Dec 2024 map reportedly labels 'MARIPOSA PARK (CITY)' just south of the hospital campus). OCII numbers Mariposa Park P26, not P27, and OCII's Sept 2023 deck lists P27 as 'when built', so showing P27 as complete is doubtful. Its 'one-seventh mile walking path shaped like a butterfly's wing' could read from above as an oval track. The owner should compare the label against OCII's 2019 Land Use Map (which reportedly puts P26 as the large green parcel between Owens St and the curved street, and P27 as a thin sliver west of Owens St) before the name, P-number or status is changed. 2026-10-02: public-text pass. accuracy_caveat, digitized_from reworded for readers (meaning unchanged; no change to the shape, status, use or geometry_type); previous wording -- accuracy_caveat: 'APPROXIMATE -- real running track/field per Esri satellite imagery and the street/already-tracked-polygon-bounded gap computation, not a surveyed footprint or named park record. properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL lot geometry -- the outline is the union of Assessor lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006 (8,217 m2, active), so its edges are recorded lot lines, not a surveyed footprint: it includes any yard, setback or plaza inside the lots and can sit a little off the park's own edge. OCII's Long-Range Property Management Plan (Attachment A, row 32) lists parcel P26 on lots 8723-003, 004, 006 and 007(p); this outline leaves out the part of lot 8723007 the plan lists, because the plan does not say which part. Until 2026-10-12 this record showed the open ground left between street centerlines and neighbouring mapped shapes (hand-picked, not a surveyed parcel); 70% of that outline lies inside the lots and it covered 100% of them. That earlier outline also took in the parking lot to the north, which is part of lot 8723008 and is no longer in this record.
